subject: Stakeholder mapping and next steps for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@summitretail.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@summitretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: stakeholder org chart and procurement steps

Hi Aisha and Carlos —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery: Summit Retail is evaluating a 3-month pilot focused on checkout latency reduction and personalization recall, with the pilot scoped for 5 storefronts and ~1M monthly requests. Key decision criteria we heard:

- Measurable latency improvement at 95th percentile
- Predictable per-token cost and clear scaling plan
- Security and data residency controls (SOC 2 + encryption in transit/at rest)

Next steps I promised on the call:
- Can you share a short org chart or list of stakeholders (economic buyer, procurement, security/legal) so we can map introductions?
- Any procurement timeline or vendor onboarding steps we should be aware of (PO, security questionnaire, SCCs)?
- I attached a draft mutual action plan and a one-pager on Redwood's pilot support model for your review.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Proposed next meeting: 30-min intro with procurement and the economic buyer (if available) — I can send 2–3 slots once you confirm stakeholders.

Thanks again — will loop in Rishi and Neha on the follow-ups for security and pricing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks — that helps a lot. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Could you please introduce Diane (finance) and the procurement contact (procurement@summitretail.com) on the thread so we can align on PO timing and approval thresholds? We typically provide a 1-page pricing summary and an SOW on the pilot.

2) Neha (cc) will take point on the security questionnaire and can share a standard SOC 2 packet and our answers to common vendor questions. Are there any specific controls or PII concerns we should call out?

3) For the pilot timeline — do you have a preferred procurement cutoff for June kick-off? If we can lock approvals by mid-June, we can onboard and start within 2–3 weeks.

Proposed intro slots (PST):
- Thu 21 May, 10:00–10:30
- Thu 21 May, 14:00–14:30
- Fri 22 May, 09:00–09:30

I'll also attach a short SLA/packaging doc to give your procurement team a sense of runbooks and escalation paths.

Thanks,
Marissa

Redwood Inference

Thanks for the follow-up. Procurement (cc) will coordinate on the PO/contract. I can be on the intro call; Diane is available but would prefer a short pricing summary ahead of a meeting.

Procurement note: we require a filled vendor security questionnaire and a current SOC 2 Type II report.
